comment:
* A minimal least-recently-used cache for libcore. Prefer {@code
 * android.util.LruCache} where that is available.
 * @hide

methods.name: public final V get(K key)
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for {@code key} if it exists in the cache or can be
     * created by {@code #create}. If a value was returned, it is moved to the
     * head of the queue. This returns null if a value is not cached and cannot
     * be created.

methods.name: public final synchronized V put(K key, V value)
methods.comment:
* Caches {@code value} for {@code key}. The value is moved to the head of
     * the queue.
     *
     * @return the previous value mapped by {@code key}. Although that entry is
     *     no longer cached, it has not been passed to {@link #entryEvicted}.

methods.name: protected void entryEvicted(K key, V value)
methods.comment:
* Called for entries that have reached the tail of the least recently used
     * queue and are be removed. The default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: protected V create(K key)
methods.comment:
* Called after a cache miss to compute a value for the corresponding key.
     * Returns the computed value or null if no value can be computed. The
     * default implementation returns null.

methods.name: public final synchronized Map<K, V> snapshot()
methods.comment:
* Returns a copy of the current contents of the cache, ordered from least
     * recently accessed to most recently accessed.

methods.name: public final synchronized void evictAll()
methods.comment: * Clear the cache, calling {@link #entryEvicted} on each removed entry.

methodNames: public final synchronized V put(K key, V value)
protected void entryEvicted(K key, V value)
public final synchronized Map<K, V> snapshot()
